title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein
subtitle: The gym-bag classic, now scoopable
intro: Chocolate whey and peanut butter already share a shelf in half the kitchens in India. Peanut butter powder adds roasted flavour and protein without extra fat, and salted peanuts finish it.

steps.text: Blend milk, peanut butter, PB powder, cocoa, sweetener, salt and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, adding the whey last, for 45–60 s until smooth.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the peanuts and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once, with a thin drizzle of peanut butter if you like.

tips: Spoon the peanut butter onto the milk, not the vessel walls, or it sticks to the plastic and never blends in.
Whey brands vary in sweetness. Taste the blended base and add sweetener only if it needs it.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin with a splash of milk before serving.
swaps: No PB powder: use 2 tbsp peanut butter in total (adds about 70 kcal and 7 g fat).
Higher protein: swap 250 ml of the milk for one pack of Amul High Protein Milk (about +27 g protein).
Gluten-free: most plain chocolate wheys are, but check the label.
shop_note: PB powder: Alpino on Amazon or Blinkit. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

title: Cookies & Cream Protein
subtitle: Vanilla protein, Oreo in every bite
intro: Skimmed milk made rich with two spoons of milk powder, so the vanilla tastes like ice cream, not a shaker bottle. Oreos go in at the end, broken by hand, for real chunks.

ingredients.item: skimmed milk, e.g. Amul Slim n Trim
skimmed milk powder, e.g. Amul Sagar

steps.text: Blend milk, milk powder, sweetener, vanilla and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45 s until no powder remains.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, drop in the broken Oreos and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once, topped with one extra crushed Oreo.

tips: Break each Oreo into 6–8 pieces by hand. Fine crumbs dissolve during MIX-IN and turn the whole pint grey.
Milk powder is the cheap trick: it adds body and milky flavour to skimmed milk with almost no fat.
For a whiter pint, use unflavoured whey and 1 tsp vanilla; many vanilla wheys tint the base beige.
swaps: Use Hide & Seek, Bourbon or Dark Fantasy pieces instead of Oreo.
Chocolate: use chocolate whey and add 1 tbsp cocoa to the base.
Lighter: use 2 Oreos (saves about 55 kcal).
shop_note: Skimmed milk powder: Amul Sagar on Blinkit or BigBasket. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

title: Kesar Pista Protein Kulfi
subtitle: Matka kulfi flavour, no hours of stirring
intro: Real kulfi means boiling milk down for an hour. Here, Amul High Protein Milk and a little milk powder give dense, rabdi-like body in minutes, while saffron and elaichi bring the matka smell.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Milk (35 g protein)

ingredients.note: 2 tbsp of it for the saffron

ingredients.item: skimmed milk powder, e.g. Amul Sagar

steps.text: Warm 2 tbsp of the toned milk for 10 s, crush in the saffron and steep 10 min. Cool to room temperature.
Blend both milks, saffron milk, milk powder, cardamom, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45 s.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and run MIX-IN.
Serve in small kulhads, topped with saffron strands and slivered pistachio.

tips: Unflavoured whey keeps the saffron in front. Vanilla whey works too; use less sweetener.
For a firmer, more kulfi-like bite, return the spun pint to the freezer for 15–20 min before scooping.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Malai kulfi: skip the saffron; add 1 tsp edible rose water and a pinch of nutmeg.
No Amul High Protein Milk: use 360 ml toned milk and 30 g whey in total (about 45 g protein).
Badam-pista: add 1 tbsp chopped almonds with the pistachios.
shop_note: Amul High Protein Milk: Blinkit, Zepto or shop.amul.com (often sells out). Kesar: Blinkit. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

title: Cold Coffee Mocha Chip Protein
subtitle: Café cold coffee, frozen solid
intro: Strong Nescafé, milk and a hit of cocoa: everything that makes a café cold coffee good, set as a scoopable pint. Dark chocolate chips go in after the spin, so they stay crunchy.

ingredients.item: instant coffee, e.g. Nescafé Classic or Bru

steps.text: Dissolve the coffee in the hot water and let it cool completely, about 5 min. Never pour hot liquid into the Blast.
Blend milk, cooled coffee, cocoa, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45 s.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the chocolate chips and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once, dusted with a little cocoa or instant coffee.

tips: Freezing mutes coffee, so the base should taste slightly too strong before it goes into the pint.
Chop a dark chocolate bar into thin shards; they melt on the tongue better than chips.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Decaf: use any decaf instant coffee for an evening pint.
Hazelnut mocha: add 1 tbsp hazelnut spread to the base and skip the cocoa.
Lighter: use skimmed milk instead of toned (saves about 70 kcal and 9 g fat).
shop_note: Morde dark chocolate chips: Amazon or BigBasket. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

title: Banana Bread Protein
subtitle: Overripe bananas, finally put to use
intro: That spotty banana nobody wants is exactly what this pint needs. It brings sweetness and body, jaggery and cinnamon add loaf-cake warmth, and toasted walnuts with an oats biscuit stand in for the crust.

ingredients.item: skimmed milk, e.g. Amul Slim n Trim

steps.text: Dry-toast the walnuts 3–4 min until fragrant; cool and chop. Break the banana into chunks.
Blend milk, banana, jaggery, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45–60 s until silky.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the walnuts and crushed biscuit, and run MIX-IN.
Serve with a pinch of cinnamon on top.

tips: The browner the banana, the sweeter the pint. Yellow bananas taste starchy and flat once frozen.
Banana makes this one of the creamiest protein pints; it rarely needs more than one re-spin.
Freeze extra ripe bananas peeled and chopped; thaw 10 min and they blend just as well.
swaps: Swap the walnuts for pecans or toasted almonds.
Choco-banana: add 1 tbsp cocoa to the base and use chocolate whey.
Gluten-free: replace the biscuit with 2 tbsp toasted rolled oats (certified gluten-free if needed).
shop_note: Jaggery powder: 24 Mantra or Organic Tattva on Blinkit or BigBasket. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake Protein
subtitle: Strawberries meet digestive biscuit crumble
intro: Greek yogurt and a spoon of cream cheese give this pint a baked-cheesecake tang, while real strawberries turn it pink without colouring. Crushed digestives go in last as the base.

ingredients.item: cream cheese, e.g. D'lecta or Go

steps.text: Blend milk, strawberries, yogurt, cream cheese, lemon juice, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 60 s until smooth and pink.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the crushed biscuits and run MIX-IN.
Top with a sliced strawberry and a little extra crumble.

tips: Soften the cream cheese for 15 min at room temperature, or it leaves white flecks in the base.
Frozen strawberries are often tarter than fresh; taste the base and add sweetener if needed.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin; add fresh crumble, as the old pieces go soft.
swaps: Blueberry cheesecake: use frozen blueberries instead of strawberries.
Mango cheesecake: use 130 g Alphonso pulp in season.
No cream cheese: use 40 g more Greek yogurt for a lighter, tangier pint.
shop_note: Frozen strawberries: Pluckk, Delishh or RealFrost on Blinkit/Zepto. Cream cheese: D'lecta on BigBasket. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

title: Thandai Protein
subtitle: Holi's favourite drink, set as a pint
intro: Fennel, black pepper, cardamom and rose make thandai the most aromatic glass of milk in India. Soft paneer blended into the base adds malai-like body and pushes the protein up.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Paneer, soft, crumbled

steps.text: Soak the almonds in hot water 15 min, then peel. Meanwhile, stir the thandai masala into the cold milk to infuse.
Blend spiced milk, almonds, paneer, rose water, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 60 s until no paneer grains remain.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Top with crushed dried rose petals and slivered almonds or pistachios, if you like.

tips: Infusing the masala in cold milk for 15 min gives a rounder spice flavour than blending it in dry.
Thandai masalas differ in pepper; start with 1 tbsp, taste the blended base and add more if needed.
Use soft, fresh paneer. Dry paneer stays grainy however long you blend it.
swaps: Homemade masala: grind 1 tbsp almonds, 1 tsp each fennel and melon seeds, ½ tsp poppy seeds, 6 peppercorns, 4 cardamom pods, 1 tsp rose petals.
Instead of paneer, use 60 g Greek yogurt for a tangier pint.
Kesar thandai: bloom 10 saffron strands in 1 tbsp warm milk, cool, and add with the rose water.
shop_note: Thandai masala: Badshah on Amazon or Blinkit. Edible rose water and dried petals: Blinkit, or Urban Platter on Amazon.

title: Lotus Biscoff Protein
subtitle: Caramelised biscuit, blended and crunched
intro: Biscoff appears twice: a spoon of spread blended into the base, then more spread and crushed biscuits folded through at the end. Greek yogurt keeps it creamy, and its slight tang tames the caramel.

steps.text: Blend milk, yogurt, 1 tbsp Biscoff spread, cinnamon, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45–60 s.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, drizzle in the loosened spread, add the crushed biscuits and run MIX-IN.
Serve with half a Biscoff biscuit tucked into each scoop.

tips: Warm the mix-in spread only until pourable, not hot; hot spread melts a channel through the ice cream.
For visible ribbons, drizzle the spread over each scoop instead of running it through MIX-IN.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin; the biscuit softens overnight, so add a few fresh pieces.
swaps: No Biscoff: crushed ginger or cinnamon biscuits give a similar spiced-caramel flavour.
Lighter: skip the mix-in spread and use 4 crushed biscuits (saves about 50 kcal).
Coffee Biscoff: dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 1 tbsp hot water, cool, and add to the base.
shop_note: Lotus Biscoff spread and biscuits: Blinkit, Zepto or Amazon. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

title: Rose Falooda Protein
subtitle: The Irani café falooda, in a pint
intro: Rooh Afza turns a plain whey base the exact pink of a Mumbai falooda and brings the rose with it. Sabja and tutti-frutti go in after the spin, so they stay soft and chewy.

mixins.item: sabja (sweet basil) seeds, soaked in 3 tbsp water
cooked falooda sev, chilled, cut short

steps.text: Soak the sabja in 3 tbsp water for 15 min, then chill. If using sev, cook as per the pack, rinse cold and chill.
Blend milk, Rooh Afza, rose water and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45 s. Taste; add sweetener only if needed.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the drained sabja, tutti-frutti and sev, and run MIX-IN.
Serve in tall glasses with an extra drizzle of Rooh Afza.

tips: Drain the sabja well; extra water freezes into icy streaks.
Keep mix-ins to about ⅓ cup in total, or MIX-IN cannot fold them through evenly.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Falooda shake: add 120 ml (½ cup) cold milk to the spun pint and run MILKSHAKE.
Kesar falooda: replace Rooh Afza with 15 saffron strands bloomed in warm milk, cooled, plus 4 spoons Sugar Free Natura.
Swap the tutti-frutti for chopped pistachios for a less sweet, crunchier pint.
shop_note: Sabja and falooda sev: Blinkit or BigBasket (Weikfield falooda mix also works). Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

title: Brownie Batter Protein
subtitle: Double chocolate with real brownie chunks
intro: Cocoa, chocolate syrup and chocolate whey make a base as dark as raw brownie batter, and a pinch of coffee deepens it. Amul High Protein Milk does most of the protein work, so you need little whey.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Milk (35 g protein)
instant coffee, e.g. Nescafé or Bru

mixins.item: brownie, in 1 cm cubes, frozen 15 min

steps.text: Blend both milks, cocoa, syrup, coffee, sweetener, salt and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 60 s so the cocoa dissolves.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM.
Cocoa bases often spin crumbly. Add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN; repeat once if needed.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the frozen brownie cubes and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once with a few brownie crumbs on top.

tips: Freeze the brownie cubes first; soft brownie smears into the ice cream instead of staying in chunks.
Cocoa makes spins more powdery, so the xanthan is especially worth adding here.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin with a splash of milk.
swaps: Protein brownie: use cubes of a chocolate protein bar (Yoga Bar, RiteBite Max Protein) instead of brownie.
No Amul High Protein Milk: use 370 ml toned milk and 35 g chocolate whey (about 44 g protein).
Mint brownie: add ¼ tsp peppermint essence to the base.
shop_note: Amul High Protein Milk: Blinkit, Zepto or shop.amul.com; stock comes and goes. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.
